payload.title: Mon 11/2: Eating out without the spiral
payload.purpose: Navigating Dining Out from the Dietary Guidance & Support pillar: how the program teaches it, one practical idea, no rules or numbers.

captions.FB: Going out to eat doesn't have to feel stressful or lead to a spiral. At the Bariatric Counseling Center, Navigating Dining Out is part of our Dietary Guidance & Support pillar. Our registered dietitians work with clients to build skills that make restaurants feel normal again, not triggering. One simple approach: before you go, decide what kind of experience you want. Not what you'll order, but how you want to feel when you leave. Satisfied? Connected to the people you're with? That intention becomes your guide, not a set of food rules. We provide group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education in one program. San Antonio and virtual across Texas. Link in the first comment.
